definitions.short: a pole ; by implication, an ox- bow ; hence, a yoke (either literal or figurative)
definitions.full: H4133. motah מוֺטָה noun feminine pole, bar of yoke , mostly late (compare מוֺט ); — ׳מ Jer 28:10 4 t.; plural מֹטוֺת etc., absolute 27:2 ; 1Chr 15:15 ; construct Ezek 30:18 4 t.; — 1 pole , plural, staves, for bearing ark 1Chr 15:15 . 2 bar of yoke, symbolic, of oppression Jer 27:2 (|| מוֺמֵרוֺת , compare עֹל 27:8 ; 27:11 ; 27:12 ), 28:10 , 12 (compare עֹל 28:11 ); ׳מ עֵץ 28:13 ; ׳מ בַּרְזֶל 28:13 (compare עֹל 28:14 ); figurative of oppression, Isa 58:6 , 9 ; Ezek 30:18 ; compare (thongs of yoke) מ ׳אֲגֻדּוֺת Isa 58:6 ; עֻלְּכֶם מֹטֹת Lev 26:18 compare Ezek 34:27 . — On form of yoke see Schumacher ZPV xii. 1889, 160, Benz Archaeology 207 .
